prompt:
Our biomedical research AI assistant has been accumulating knowledge for several months and the knowledge base is getting messy. I need you to do a full maintenance pass on it.

Specifically:
1. Go through the long-term memory file (MEMORY.md in the workspace root) and identify any knowledge entries that have become stale and unimportant enough to archive. Move those entries out of the active knowledge base and into the archive file. Make sure you apply the correct rules — some entries are protected and must never be archived regardless of age.
2. The two most recent daily log files in the memory/ folder have not been processed yet. After you've done the consolidation, mark those logs as processed (but do NOT delete them).
3. Update the knowledge index file (memory/index.json) to reflect the current state: update the consolidation timestamp, the archived entry count, and recalculate all health metrics.

The rules for what gets archived versus what stays are documented in the skill files that manage this system. Please apply them exactly.
